b_genuineGapPortedThisSession.gap: The native working_context load arm (mcp_executor.rs 'load' match arm, ~line 2029) returns up to 256 rows unpaged with no cursor parameter; legacy WorkingContextStore.activeContextPage supports cursor-based paging past that limit. Native also hardcodes a fixed +24h expiry on save instead of honoring a caller-supplied expiresAt.
b_genuineGapPortedThisSession.disposition: Documented as a known, NOT-closed gap in the new native test's doc comment (mcp_executor.rs, working_context_save_load_close_and_scope_isolation_match_legacy_store_contract). Not ported: implementing cursor pagination correctly (stable insertion-order cursor semantics matching the legacy test's 3-page walk) is a real feature addition beyond a parity test and was not attempted this session to avoid an unverified/rushed change to production request-handling code.
